screen.tap_multi: Tap — each code switches its entity
screen.failed: Not sent. Is the screen connected?

app.name: Keypad Multi
app.summary: Keypad with several codes: each code switches its own entity. Can sit beside the original Keypad plugin.
app.tile_example: Enter the code to switch it
app.target_hint: What code 1 switches: a lock, cover, switch, light, script, scene or button.
app.code_hint: 4 to 8 digits for entity 1. Stored on the screen: use for convenience, not as your only lock.
app.code_entity_hint: Instead of code 1: an input_text or text entity (4–16 digits). Overrides only code 1. Leave the helper out of the recorder.
app.target_n_hint: Another entity, switched only by its own code. Leave empty if unused.
app.code_n_hint: Code for the entity above only. Leave empty if unused.
app.free_close_hint: On: a tap locks/closes/switches off entity 1 at once without the code. Unlocking and the other codes still need a code.
app.auto_check_hint: On: checked as soon as the last digit of a code is typed. Off: only the check key checks it.
app.attempts_hint: After this many wrong codes in a row the keypad waits.
app.wait_hint: How long the keypad waits, in seconds.
